# monitoring-mcp

> FastMCP 3.4.4+ MCP server for Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, and Alertmanager — query, correlate, and manage observability via portmanteau tools.

## Docs

- [README](README.md) — overview, features, compose
- [INSTALL](INSTALL.md) — just / uv / MCPB / containers
- [Configuration](docs/CONFIGURATION.md) — `MONITORING_MCP_*` env vars
- [Tools](docs/TOOLS.md) — all portmanteau operations (implemented)
- [Podman](docs/PODMAN.md) — Podman Compose and host gateway URLs
- [Development](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) — tests, architecture, standards
- [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)
- [PRD](PRD.md)

## Tools

- `grafana_management` — dashboards, panels, folders, datasources, alerts, export/import
- `prometheus_monitoring` — PromQL, targets, rules, silences (Alertmanager), Grafana alert CRUD
- `loki_logging` — LogQL, WebSocket tail, export, compare, ruler
- `cross_system_correlation` — incident, root cause, bottlenecks, dependencies
- `monitoring_status` — health, connectivity, storage, security, capacity

## Config

- Prefix: `MONITORING_MCP_`
- Endpoints: `GRAFANA_URL`, `PROMETHEUS_URL`, `LOKI_URL`, `ALERTMANAGER_URL`
- Transport: `MCP_TRANSPORT` = `stdio` | `http` | `sse`
